title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech-led selloff, energy spikes.  
Large caps sold off across the board, led by SOXX –5.38% and QQQ –2.04%, as semiconductor earnings (KLAC, VRT) disappointed. Energy surged +1.88% on oil +7.32%, but broader risk appetite crumbled, with defensive staples the only other gainer. The tape was narrow risk-off disguised as rotation: money left tech/industrials for energy and staples.

INDICES — VIX 20.7, up vs 20d MA 17.2.  
Rank: SPY –1.54%, IWM –1.64%, QQQ –2.04%, DIA –2.18%, SOXX –5.38%. Small > large by 0.18pp. Cross-asset: USO +7.32%. SPY and QQQ both below 200-day MA — CTA sell triggers.

VOLUME — SPY vol ratio not listed; QQQ at 1.6x (declining volume).  
DIA 2.3x and SOXX 1.9x saw elevated volume and price down = distribution. QQQ volume fading while price falling suggests low conviction selling from CTA-driven flows.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.88%, XLP Staples +0.34%, XLRE Real Estate –0.11%, XLC Comms –0.15%, XLV Healthcare –0.61%, XLY Discretionary –0.77%, XLB Materials –1.15%, XLU Utilities –1.34%, XLF Financials –1.60%, XLK Technology –2.64%, XLI Industrials –3.19%.  
Top industries: USO +7.32%, FCG +3.84%; bottom: SOXX –5.38%, WGMI –11.99%.  
Money flowing into Energy and Staples; out of Tech and Industrials. Rotation label: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY put-call vol ratio 1.43, QQQ 1.35 — protection demand elevated.  
VIX 20.7 vs 20d MA 17.2, fear rising. IWM PCR 2.02 extreme. No MOVE data. Skew positive across options, confirming put premium.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +7.32% crushed Industrials –3.19% via cost shock, while Energy gained only +1.88% — oil producers lagged the commodity move. Dollar –0.56% cushioned gold +0.46% but did not boost EM or cyclicals.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 61.2 (Greed).  
Top movers: VRT –17.26% (Buildout 7, distribution), MDLZ +4.02% (Staples, accumulation), SOXX –5.38% (semis, distribution). 20d momentum: best sector XLE +10.43%, worst XLK –12.57%.  
Watch: MDLZ — vol spike + price up accumulation, break from staples rotation; TT –4.94% with 2.3x vol, distribution into earnings; SOXX –5.38% on 1.9x vol, testing March 2026 lows.
